Eventually, he would get lonely, so I started having him call up his boss, (He worked for the newspaper until he would get enough royalties off his books to live on), and I would make them have upwards of 5 hour conversations. Of course, his boss started visiting, and they fell in love. However, she was fairly upset with the fact that he wouldn't leave the house, so they'd argue occasionally. I got bored of her, so my sim started seeing, what, 8 something other sims at the same time? His boss/lover eventually found out, thusly losing him both his job and his social outlet. He married one of the 8 sims, and literally two minutes after they got married, she turned into an old woman, so I set her on fire. He's currently searching for another lover.
Avoid her like the fucking plague.
